nameEn: Wholesale of other machinery and equipment
description: This class includes the wholesale of other machinery and equipment not elsewhere classified.
includes: wholesale of office machinery and equipment: typewriters, calculators, fax machines
wholesale of construction and civil engineering machinery and equipment
wholesale of mining and quarrying machinery, equipment and supplies
wholesale of industrial machinery, equipment and supplies
wholesale of ships, aircraft and other transport equipment (excluding motor vehicles)
wholesale of transport equipment (except motor vehicles, motorcycles and bicycles)
